intentionalAdaptations: Run the supported CRUD/filter/count subset against the Convex component and an independent deterministic in-memory reference model; joins, numeric IDs, UUID IDs, offsets, and transactions are intentionally unsupported.
Exercise Better Auth factory transformation separately for forceAllowId and logical-to-physical field names before the component boundary.
Extend the upstream increment contract with Convex-specific concurrent decrement, overflow, set-overlap, return-value, trigger, and transaction-rollback proofs.

Require public count to delegate once to the component's single-snapshot count query, require count and fully paginated findMany to select the same rows, and reject atomic bulk/relationship plans above the reviewed 128-row transaction budget before any write or trigger effect.

records.modificationSummary: Reworked the adapter factory around logical IDs, indexed relationships, atomic component writes, single-snapshot counts, and fail-closed provider ID-token encryption. The 2026-09-15 renewal extension carries request-local rotation-parent and consent identity into component writes, binds refresh reads to the presented client, and reports retryable concurrent rotation without exposing token material.

Rebuilt component functions with strict validation, indexed relationships, failure-atomic writes and triggers, single-snapshot counts, one atomic rate-limit consume operation, guarded consumption and increments, authenticated signing-key rotation, component-owned session-generation invalidation and admission, and scheduled physical session expiry. The 2026-09-15 renewal extension admits refresh reads and writes against current canonical authority, bounds child expiry by the original session and parent, and revokes consent for provider family invalidation while limiting physical refresh-history cleanup.

Extracted one precomputed, cycle-safe relationship engine for indexed parent validation and table-qualified atomic cascade, restrict, and set-null planning. The 2026-09-15 renewal extension permits session, user, and client deletion without traversing unbounded refresh history; retained rows lose authority through live admission, while creation and reference-changing writes still require valid parents.

Rewrote deterministic schema and metadata generation for logical IDs, canonical nullability, reserved session-generation fields, explicit supported deletion policies, indexed relationship lookups, collision-safe adapter indexes, and a stable model fingerprint. The 2026-09-15 renewal extension reserves bcnConsentId on refresh rows and marks this immutable grant binding as unavailable to caller input and updates.

Split logical-to-physical field and executable relationship metadata into one typed contract shared by generation and adapter operations, with one fail-closed mismatch result for malformed or divergent schemas.

Rebuilt filtering, capped and cap-free atomic collection, bounded-memory count paging, index selection, sorting, and cursor pagination around fail-closed logical-field semantics and explicit unsupported-query rejection.

Added component-owned user and session generations so the provider's canonical delete-all selector atomically invalidates every earlier session without an unbounded collection scan; stale sessions fail adapter reads and backend admission until scheduled physical expiry. Owns the internal component admission read that requires an unexpired session whose generation matches its user.
Regenerated the component API declarations from the Better Convex Nuxt component.

Regenerated the public ComponentApi declaration including relationship-aware writes, atomic rate-limit consumption, guarded consumption and increments, signing-key lifecycle operations, and persisted-session admission. Regenerated on 2026-09-15 for the optional oauthRefreshParentId create argument and oauthRefreshGrantId family-deletion argument.
Regenerated the component data-model declarations from the curated core schema.
Regenerated the component server declarations from the Better Convex Nuxt component.

Reduced the component adapter to a thin assembly of the shared adapter functions, including persisted-session admission, scheduled session expiry, atomic rate-limit consumption, and atomic signing-key rotation.
Rewrote the fixed component definition for the curated Better Convex Nuxt schema and functions.

Generated adapter metadata with required session-generation fields and explicit indexed relationship and deletion policies for the exact stable Better Auth 1.7.2 account identity, OAuth provider, JWKS, and database rate-limit schema. Regenerated on 2026-09-15 with the reserved, non-updatable bcnConsentId refresh-row field and the resulting canonical fingerprint.
Rewrote one deterministic greenfield Better Auth, JWT, OAuth, and database rate-limit schema profile.

Regenerated the fresh-install component schema and relationship indexes from the fixed Better Auth 1.7.2 profile, including stable account identity, session-generation authority, and OAuth application metadata fields. Regenerated on 2026-09-15 with the optional bcnConsentId refresh-row field for immutable consent binding.
Retained only the context types and writable-context guard required by the integrated adapter.

Reduced the component client to one maintained adapter and route surface with component-owned persisted-session admission, provider-owned OAuth access revalidation, signed proxy-IP resolution, final-session validation, and authenticated JWKS rotation.

Introduced one reviewed factory that owns adapter wiring, JWT and plugin ordering, route registration, keys, secrets, projections, OAuth operations, and atomic database rate-limit storage; admits fail-closed request-scoped email and user-creation policy, keeps arbitrary plugins limited to the internal loopback-only test constructor, and lets that constructor revalidate its boundary for every auth instance.

Replaced the compatibility barrel with the fixed narrow Better Convex Nuxt API, including the reviewed auth factory, maintained component, atomic rate-limit storage constructor, provider, Better Auth MCP access verifier and OAuth operator, and rebuildable user projection. The 2026-09-15 public type surface also exports OAuthLiveAccess for the application live-authority callback.
Replaced inferred and forwarded origins with strict SITE_URL and CONVEX_SITE_URL lookup through the shared parser.

Added one package-owned Better Auth custom storage boundary that delegates the complete rate-limit decision and counter update to one atomic component mutation and retries only exact final uncommitted Convex contention from an action context with a fixed bound.

Rewrote the Convex plugin as the composition, request-guard, and session-issuance owner; exact OAuth Provider compatibility, package-owned atomic rate-limit storage, and operator calls live behind fail-closed guards. The 2026-09-15 extension admits the explicit renewable profile in bounded token and revocation guards and projects its refresh grant in authorization-server metadata.
Isolated the upstream bearer-assisted session-token flow behind one fixed in-process header that both public HTTP boundaries strip before dispatch.

Replaced public lazy key creation and destructive rollover with pinned Better Auth RS256 generation, encrypted-private and public-only JWK validation, authenticated atomic winner initialization, additive rotation, and bounded grace-period retention.

Added one request-scoped operator for preregistered public OAuth clients with asynchronously resolved admitted scopes, safe redirect schemes, explicit application-owned resources, fixed provider security fields, deterministic rollback of partial writes, and no user-session dependency. The 2026-09-15 extension admits resource scope supersets, creates resources from the canonical profile scope set, and enables client refresh grants only when offline_access was admitted.

Added provider security and token invariants behind a local structural profile that does not expose provider-private types: mandatory fail-closed privilege callbacks, bounded request parsing, canonical exact HTTPS or HTTP-loopback redirects, token-method client classification, stable application-type validation, opaque join-row identity with compound client/resource binding, S256 PKCE, projected metadata, access-token claim validation, and the documented time-bounded URL.canParse capability fill. The 2026-09-15 extension validates the fixed seven-day renewal and ten-second retry profile, reserves and verifies the immutable bcn_grant_id claim, and advertises refresh only for that profile.

Isolated the exact-version Better Auth OAuth Provider compatibility firewall: scoped Lupinum plugin identity and order, installed callback identity, disabled upstream routes, fixed JWT/JWKS and storage profile, production proxy requirement, stable application-type projection, retired-field rejection, and safe administrator client/resource mutations. The 2026-09-15 extension requires the package-owned adapter for renewal and validates the exact installed grant list, refresh lifetime, and retry interval against the configured profile.
Replaced upstream type inference with one internal fixed GET action for the maintained same-origin Convex session-token route.

Added bounded compact-JWT and canonical-JWKS validation around pinned-provider JOSE verification, with HTTPS-only production endpoints and exact loopback HTTP development endpoints, followed by exact issuer, audience, client, subject, scope, session, and token-class binding. The 2026-09-15 extension passes the verified immutable grant identity into live-access validation.

Separated verified-token parsing from provider-owned live authority and rechecks component-owned persisted-session admission plus the current client, resource, compound link, consent, expiry, and scopes before every MCP request without assuming provider-owned row IDs. The 2026-09-15 extension requires renewable access to carry its original consent identity and rejects a replacement consent even when client, resource, and scopes match.
Rewrote the Convex JWT provider so issuer and JWKS authority resolve only from the validated Convex deployment site origin.

Compiled the component test registration helper against the exact packaged schema and modules, and added a test-only auth constructor that admits Better Auth test utilities only while both configured origins remain validated loopback URLs.
Consolidated only the maintained trigger, relationship-aware write, auth-factory, guarded-consume, atomic-increment, and authenticated signing-key lifecycle component API types.

Extracted the optional application-user trigger path into one explicitly derived and rebuildable projection helper whose validated indexed auth key is owned by the helper, cannot be overridden by consumer callbacks, uses a bounded lookup, fails closed on ambiguous survivors, and recreates a missing projection from the current canonical update snapshot.
Extracted the fixed RS256 JWT and encrypted signing-key policy into one shared runtime and build-time plugin constructor.

Original Better Convex extension of the rewritten component API seam; no upstream refresh implementation is copied. Admits renewal from live provider session, client, resource, link, and immutable consent rows; constrains child expiry and privileges to the original session and rotation parent; revokes only the consent bound to a rejected or revoked family.

Original Better Convex extension of the rewritten provider integration seam; no upstream refresh implementation is copied. Uses the official Better Auth request context, APIError, and Basic-auth decoder to carry rotation-parent and presented-grant evidence for one request, bind the requesting client, emit retryable busy responses, and issue the immutable consent claim; Convex retains persistence authority.
